_README: Machine-readable context manifest for coding agents. Read this (or run `ctx`) BEFORE reading the codebase. Invariants are asserted against config.py by tests/test_context_map.py (anti-drift). JSON (not YAML) to avoid adding a runtime dependency to the deployed venv.

invariants._note: Source of truth is config.py; these are asserted equal by tests/test_context_map.py.

param_claims._README: Drift-prone strategy params bound to their config.py source of truth — generalizes invariant_sources beyond the safety/identity invariants. Asserted by tests/test_context_map.py::TestParamClaims: each `source` must resolve and each `value` must equal the live config value, and any explicit `KEY=value` mention in CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md must match. Query these (or `ctx config <KEY>` for the live value) instead of trusting prose — CLAUDE.md headline/§6 numbers are flagged stale. Changing a param means updating config.py AND `value` here; CI fails when they diverge.

claims.note: Daily mean-reversion max hold. CLAUDE.md §6 still records 20 (stale, baselined in KNOWN_DOC_PARAM_DRIFT).
BTC daily oversold threshold (38 not 30 — catches shallow bull dips).
Active live mode target (1.00%). NB config.py comment mislabels it 2.80% — see `ctx audit`.
Active live mode stop (0.50%). NB config.py comment mislabels it 1.50% — see `ctx audit`.

graph_bridges._README: Curated idea↔code edges linking RESEARCH_WEB.md nodes to the code/config they concern — the connective tissue that lets an agent editing a symbol discover the finding about it (and vice-versa). Asserted by tests/test_context_map.py::TestGraphBridges: every `node` must exist in the web and every `code` target must resolve (file::symbol defined, or config.KEY exists). Surfaced by `ctx web <node>`, `ctx impact <symbol|config.KEY>`, and the unified `ctx walk/why/neighbors`. relation ∈ {concerns, implemented_in, measured_by, gated_by}.

bridges.note: The fixed %-target/%-stop exit is the architectural flaw; a multi-day horizon exit would replace it here.
stop-vs-intrabar-noise ratio drives win rate — the stop pct is the lever (3x ETFs stop inside noise).
the live bot trades full sessions → flat; the hourly edge was a morning-only sampling artifact.
backtest↔live data mismatch root cause (710d fetch = morning-only) + the chunked re-pull fix.
daily mean-reversion is a real serial-correlation property; the entry signal exploits it.
goal reachable only as diversified daily-MR + horizon exit — not the hourly %-stop bot; the exit is the highest-value change.
promote rolling-origin OOS to the sweep's primary selector.
the live instrument (TQQQ) is fragile — collapses to t=0.37 on recent data.

live_trader.summary: The hourly scheduler + entry/exit/reconcile loop that places paper bracket orders.

signals.summary: Signal feature engineering: RSI/MACD/regime, VWAP z-score, ADX/Bollinger.

strategy_engine.summary: Feature orchestration, signal routing/regime gate, and trade-return simulation.

backtest.summary: Backtest loop + performance metrics + data ingestion; universal param sweep entrypoint.

optimization.summary: Parameter-SELECTION decision layer: walk-forward optimizer + the sweep's scoring/sizing/cost/reproducibility helpers. This is what picks production params — test it, don't trust it blindly (its metrics were the misleading headline source).

dashboard.summary: Read-only FastAPI monitor; current/all/archive run-window view.

ops.summary: Systemd timers + ops scripts for paper data collection, health, export, archive.

config.summary: Single source of truth for all tunable params and mode routing.

avoid: trusting holdout-selected sweep numbers (selection-biased) — prefer the leak-free walkforward_eval
changing the default sweep objective/sizing/selection without sign-off

coverage_allowlist._README: First-party .py modules intentionally NOT owned by an 'areas' entry, with the reason. Enforced by tests/test_area_coverage.py: every first-party module must be claimed by an area OR listed here (so a NEW orphaned module fails CI and gets triaged, instead of silently going un-mapped). __init__.py are empty package markers; the two tools below are read-only agent/diagnostic CLIs (advertised in tools_readonly), not strategy areas.

edit_policy._README: Checked by `ctx can_edit <file>` and the (opt-in) PreToolUse hook ops/guard_edit.py. READ access is unrestricted; only WRITES are fenced. deny = armed-trader path + secrets + raw DBs; warn = selection-of-record.

routing_synonyms._README: concept -> keywords that exist in routing[].keywords. ctx route expands the query through these so plain-English questions reach the right rule.

facts.recent_changes: run: ctx recent   (git log on deploy branch)
facts.tests_for_area: run: ctx tests <area>   (e.g. ctx tests optimization)
facts.research_idea_web: run: ctx web   (findings/hypotheses/experiments/decisions graph; `ctx web F3` for a node). The honest edge evidence + open questions live here.
facts.sweep_sizing: sweep defaults to live fixed-10% (resolve_sizing, sweep_sizing.py); --sizing/--adaptive override. Backtest 'fixed' mode == live get_position_plan.
facts.sweep_objective: default 'sharpe' (live_score); '--objective ev' = net-of-cost EV, hard-rejects <34% WR (sweep_scoring.py, opt-in). Do NOT change the default selection without sign-off.
facts.sweep_cost_realism: round-trip spread cost is baked into EV (sweep_costs.round_trip_cost_pct); scoring penalties are skipped on negative-base scores (else they perversely improve losing configs).

conventions: Read this manifest (or run `ctx`) first; drill into deep docs only at the cited section.
Prefer a tool call over a file read for any computable fact (state, schema, symbol, diff).
Cite file:line so the next agent can jump there.
Respect invariants: paper-only, port 7497 never 7496; do not edit do_not_touch_without_approval areas without explicit approval.
Never commit .env / raw .db / logs / credentials / account IDs; push via SSH, never to main.
